# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the registered tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

The engineering bundle registers **49 tools** for L5X and FactoryTalk View. Each tool answers with a summary,
structured data and suggested next calls; expected failures return a code, a message and a fix.
See [Examples](../examples.md) for end-to-end usage and the [README](../../README.md) for components and switches.

| Product | Group | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| L5X | L5X read | 4 |
| L5X | L5X references | 5 |
| L5X | L5X checks | 2 |
| L5X | L5X drafts | 9 |
| L5X | L5X Studio SDK | 6 |
| L5X | L5X controller | 7 |
| L5X | L5X live | 2 |
| FactoryTalk View | FTView read | 6 |
| FactoryTalk View | FTView edit | 5 |
| FactoryTalk View | FTView Studio | 3 |

## L5X

### L5X read

Open a Studio 5000 L5X export and read its structure and components.

#### `open_project`

Open one Studio 5000 L5X export for this chat. Returns a project_id and a structure summary; every other tool reads this project.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path to the .L5X export, absolute or relative to the workspace root. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/Line.L5X" |

#### `project_overview`

Structure and coverage of the open project: controller, revision, tasks, programs and component counts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `list_components`

List one component kind in the open project, paginated. Use it to find the exact name get_component expects.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string (program \| task \| tag \| udt \| routine \| aoi \| module \| alarm) | yes | Component kind to list. |
| `scope` | string | no | Program name for a program-scoped tag or routine. Omit for controller scope. |
| `filter` | string | no | Case-insensitive substring matched against the component name. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Zero-based index of the first row to return. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum rows to return. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `get_component`

Read one component in full by exact name: a tag, UDT, routine, AOI, module, program, task or alarm.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string (program \| task \| tag \| udt \| routine \| aoi \| module \| alarm) | yes | Component kind to read. |
| `name` | string | yes | Exact component name as the export declares it. |
| `scope` | string | no | Program name when the component is program-scoped. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

### L5X references

Follow a symbol through exported logic without opening every routine.

#### `search_logic`

Find literal text in routine logic. Use it to locate a rung, ST line or operand when you do not know the exact symbol name; use find_references when you do.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Case-insensitive text to find, matched literally inside rung text, ST lines and diagram node labels. Example: "OTE(Motor_Run)". |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum matches to return. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `find_references`

Find where one symbol is read or written in exported logic, with scope, access and confidence. Use trace_dependencies for what feeds a symbol.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | string | yes | Symbol to follow, as declared or as written in logic. Example: "Motor_1" or "Program:MainProgram.Motor_1". |
| `scope` | string | no | Program scope to search. Omit to search every scope. |
| `detail` | string (summary \| evidence) | no | How much evidence to return. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum evidence rows when detail is "evidence". |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `trace_dependencies`

Follow what feeds a symbol (upstream) or what it feeds (downstream) through parsed operands. Static evidence only; it does not establish runtime causality.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | string | yes | Symbol to trace. Example: "Conveyor_Run" or "AOI_EncoderScale::Out_FPM". |
| `scope` | string | no | Program or AOI name that declares the symbol. Omit for controller scope; an AOI::Member symbol resolves against that AOI automatically. |
| `direction` | string (upstream \| downstream) | no | Which way to follow the graph. |
| `depth` | integer | no | Maximum graph depth to follow. Default 3. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `resolve_tag`

Resolve one Logix address against exported declarations: alias chain, member, integer bit and array subscript, with the evidence that remains unverified.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | yes | Address as written in logic. Example: "Motor_1.Speed" or "Alarms[2].3". |
| `scope` | string | no | Program scope for a local tag. Omit for controller scope. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `usage_map`

Map how one declared tag is used: which array elements and bits are read or written, which remain free, and where each appears.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string | yes | Declared tag name. Example: "Alarm_Bits". |
| `scope` | string | no | Declaring scope: "controller" or a program name. Defaults to controller. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

### L5X checks

Evidence-backed structural checks and export comparison.

#### `run_checks`

Run evidence-backed engineering checks on the open project: unused tags, unresolved references, unscheduled programs and undocumented logic. Pass baseline_id to add I/O change checks against an earlier export.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline_id` | string | no | Optional second open project id to compare against, enabling I/O module change checks. |
| `rule` | string | no | Only return findings with this exact rule name. Example: "UNUSED_TAG". |
| `severity` | string (info \| warning \| critical) | no | Only return findings with this severity. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Zero-based index of the first finding to return. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum findings to return. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `compare_projects`

Compare two open exports by engineering component: programs, tasks, tags, UDTs, AOIs, modules, alarms, routines, rungs, ST bodies and diagrams. Export timestamps and XML formatting are ignored.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before_id` | string | yes | Project id of the earlier export. Open both exports first with open_project. |
| `after_id` | string | yes | Project id of the later export. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Zero-based index of the first change to return. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum changes to return. |

### L5X drafts

Stage edits in a chat draft. `draft_apply` writes one new L5X beside the source and never overwrites it.

#### `draft_rung`

Append one ladder rung operation to the chat draft: replace, insert or delete. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | string | yes | Program that owns the routine. Example: "MainProgram". |
| `routine` | string | yes | Routine the rung belongs to. Example: "MainRoutine". |
| `mode` | string (replace \| insert \| delete) | yes | replace rewrites an existing rung, insert adds one, delete removes one. |
| `rung` | integer | no | Rung number the operation targets. Required for replace and delete; for insert it is the new rung number. |
| `text` | string | no | NeutralText for replace or insert. Omit for delete. Example: "XIC(Start)OTE(Run);" |
| `before_rung` | integer | no | For insert only: insert before this rung number instead of after rung. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_st`

Append one Structured Text body replacement to the chat draft. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | string | yes | Program that owns the routine. Example: "MainProgram". |
| `routine` | string | yes | Structured Text routine to replace. Example: "Calc". |
| `code` | string | yes | Full replacement body, one statement per line. Example: "Counter := Counter + 1;\nIF Counter > 10 THEN Counter := 0; END_IF;" |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_routine`

Append one new routine to the chat draft. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | string | yes | Program that will own the new routine. Example: "MainProgram". |
| `name` | string | yes | New routine name, a Logix identifier of at most 40 characters. Example: "Calc". |
| `language` | string (RLL \| ST) | yes | Language of the new routine: RLL for ladder, ST for Structured Text. |
| `code` | string | yes | Body: NeutralText rungs for RLL, statements for ST. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_tag`

Append one new tag to the chat draft. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | Declaring scope: "controller" or a program name. Example: "controller". |
| `name` | string | yes | New tag name, a Logix identifier of at most 40 characters. Example: "SP_Start". |
| `data_type` | string | yes | Declared data type. Example: "REAL" or a UDT name. |
| `description` | string | yes | Tag description shown in Studio. Example: "Start threshold". |
| `value` | integer | no | Optional scalar initial value. Example: 80. |
| `dimensions` | string | no | Optional array dimensions, space separated. Example: "4 2". |
| `external_access` | string (Read/Write \| Read Only \| None) | no | Optional external access. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_tag_description`

Append one existing tag description change to the chat draft. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | Declaring scope: "controller" or a program name. |
| `name` | string | yes | Existing tag name. Example: "LineSpeed". |
| `description` | string | yes | New description text for the existing tag. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_udt_member`

Append one new member to a standard data type in the chat draft. Refused later if the type already has instances. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `udt` | string | yes | Existing standard data type name. Example: "Motor_UDT". |
| `name` | string | yes | New member name. Example: "Speed". |
| `data_type` | string | yes | Member data type. Example: "REAL". |
| `description` | string | yes | Description text for the new member. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_udt_description`

Append one standard data type description change, or one member description change when member is supplied. Nothing is written until draft_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `udt` | string | yes | Existing standard data type name. |
| `member` | string | no | Member name to change. Omit to change the type description itself. |
| `description` | string | yes | New description text for the type or the member. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_validate`

Validate the accumulated draft against the open project and return its hash, diff summary and check findings. Writes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | string | no | Draft handle returned by a draft_* tool. Omit when exactly one draft exists in this chat. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `draft_apply`

Apply the validated draft to ONE new L5X file beside the source. Never overwrites, never imports into Studio, never contacts a controller.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | string | no | Draft handle returned by a draft_* tool. Omit when exactly one draft exists in this chat. |
| `output_path` | string | yes | New .L5X path to write. It must not exist. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

### L5X Studio SDK

Logix Designer SDK: export, verify, build and evidence review. Requires Studio 5000 and the SDK service.

#### `studio_sdk_status`

Preflight the Logix Designer SDK service, FactoryTalk Linx services, SDK package, .NET and installed Studio versions. Call before any SDK tool; no project or controller operation.

No parameters.

#### `studio_capabilities`

Report offline, SDK, revision-specific build, reference and live-read capabilities with next steps. Optional project_id checks the selected revision; no controller contact.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |

#### `export_acd_to_l5x`

Export one existing offline ACD to a new full L5X with the running Logix Designer SDK service. No controller connection or upload; refuses to overwrite.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acd_path` | string | yes | Existing offline ACD. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/Line.ACD". |
| `output_path` | string | yes | New .L5X path to write. It must not exist. |

#### `verify_offline_l5x`

Import a full L5X into a new offline ACD and build it with the Studio SDK. Build needs project revision 37+; probe=true attempts a lower revision and reports the SDK error. No controller operation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `baseline_id` | string | yes | Project handle of the unchanged baseline export this draft came from. Example: "3f2c...". |
| `output_path` | string | yes | New .ACD path to write. It must not exist. |
| `probe` | boolean | no | Attempt the build on a revision below 37 and report the SDK error instead of refusing early. |

#### `build_acd_from_draft`

Import one changed existing RLL or ST routine into a NEW offline ACD copy, build it, export it, and check preservation. No controller connection; requires the original ACD and a baseline exported in this chat.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acd_path` | string | yes | Original offline ACD the baseline was exported from. |
| `baseline_id` | string | yes | Project handle of the unchanged baseline export. |
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `program` | string | yes | Program that owns the changed routine. Example: "MainProgram". |
| `routine` | string | yes | Routine whose edited logic is imported. Example: "MainRoutine". |
| `output_path` | string | yes | New .ACD path to write. It must not exist. |
| `result_export_path` | string | yes | New .L5X path for the built ACD export. It must not exist. |

#### `studio_review_evidence`

Before reporting Studio findings, verify exact program, routine and rung or ST line names with verbatim quotes. Does not verify interpretation or runtime behavior.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `citations` | string | yes | Citations to verify, one per line or as JSON. Example: "MainProgram/MainRoutine rung 4: XIC(Start)OTE(Run);" |

### L5X controller

Supervised controller access. Upload, mode changes and downloads require per-call human approval.

#### `controller_approval_status`

Read this session's permission preset and human-approval policy before upload, mode change or download. Full access normally cannot ask for approval. No SDK, file search or controller access.

No parameters.

#### `capture_controller_snapshot`

Upload from the supplied controller IP to a new local ACD. Resolve the exact FactoryTalk Linx route from a named ACD or L5X; requires per-call human approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address the human named. Example: "192.168.1.10". |
| `route_project_path` | string | yes | ACD or L5X whose saved communications path names the controller route. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/Line.ACD". |
| `output_path` | string | yes | New .ACD path for the upload. It must not exist. |

#### `go_online`

Connect a matching ACD to a controller for read-only diagnostics. Does not change mode or controller data.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_path` | string | yes | ACD uploaded from that controller. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/Upload.ACD". |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address. Example: "192.168.1.10". |

#### `read_controller_mode`

Read controller mode for the explicitly supplied controller IP. Supply the matching snapshot ACD to avoid reimporting an L5X. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address. Example: "192.168.1.10". |
| `snapshot_path` | string | no | Optional matching ACD upload. Omit to use the open project’s path for the route. |

#### `read_live_tag`

Read one controller-scoped scalar BOOL, INT, DINT or REAL from a matching uploaded ACD. Supply the declared data type; read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_path` | string | yes | ACD uploaded from that controller. |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address. |
| `tag` | string | yes | Controller-scoped tag name. Example: "LineSpeed". |
| `data_type` | string (BOOL \| INT \| DINT \| REAL) | yes | Declared scalar type. |

#### `change_controller_mode`

Change controller mode to Program, Run or Test. Requires per-call human approval for the exact controller and target mode.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_path` | string | yes | Matching ACD for the controller. |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address. |
| `target_mode` | string (Program \| Run \| Test) | yes | Mode the human approved. |

#### `download_project`

Download only an ACD built and reviewed by verify_offline_l5x or build_acd_from_draft in this chat, using its verification_id. Requires per-call human approval; never changes mode automatically.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `verification_id` | string | yes | Verification id returned by a passed offline build. Example: "b1f2...". |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address the human named. |

### L5X live

Direct EtherNet/IP reads with no Studio, FactoryTalk Linx or ACD snapshot.

#### `poll_live_tags`

Read declared scalar PLC tags directly over EtherNet/IP without Studio, FactoryTalk Linx, an ACD upload or the SDK. Explicit controller IPv4 and slot required. Returns timestamped sweeps, quality and controller identity; no writes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address the human named. Example: "192.168.1.10". |
| `slot` | integer | no | CPU slot, 0 to 31. Default 0. |
| `tags` | array | yes | Controller-scoped scalar tags to read, 1 to 16. Each entry names the tag and optionally its program. |
| `sample_count` | integer | no | Number of sweeps to read. Default 1. |
| `interval_ms` | integer | no | Requested interval between sweeps. Default 200. |

#### `start_plc_trend`

Start a bounded, read-only PLC trend as a session-owned background job. Explicit IPv4, slot and declared scalar tags required. SDK-independent EtherNet/IP; the chart follows the job without a model call per sample.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | no | Handle returned by open_project. Omit when exactly one project is open in this chat. |
| `ip_address` | string | yes | Controller IPv4 address the human named. Example: "192.168.1.10". |
| `slot` | integer | no | CPU slot, 0 to 31. Default 0. |
| `tags` | array | yes | Controller-scoped scalar tags to read, 1 to 16. Each entry names the tag and optionally its program. |
| `sample_count` | integer | no | Number of sweeps in the trend. Default 300. |
| `interval_ms` | integer | no | Requested interval between sweeps. Default 200. |


## FactoryTalk View

### FTView read

Open a FactoryTalk View ME export and read displays and HMI tags.

#### `ftview_open`

Open one FactoryTalk View ME export folder and return its application summary: displays, tag rows, structural diagnostics and coverage. Read-only; does not decode MER, contact a terminal, or change files.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | string | yes | Export folder containing the display XML files and the HMI tag CSV. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/ME Export". |

#### `ftview_list`

List the displays or the HMI tags in one opened export, with a name filter and paging.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `kind` | string (display \| tag) | yes | What to list: the display files or the HMI tag rows. |
| `filter` | string | no | Optional case-insensitive substring for the display or tag name. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of rows to skip. Default 0. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Most rows to return. Default 50, maximum 200. |

#### `ftview_get`

Read one display or one HMI tag in full: a display exposes its named objects; a tag exposes its CSV row.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `kind` | string (display \| tag) | yes | What to read: one display file or one HMI tag row. |
| `name` | string | yes | Exact display name or tag name. Example: "Main" or "StartPB". |

#### `ftview_find`

Search one opened export by name or text across displays, display objects and HMI tags.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `query` | string | yes | Text to search for, case-insensitive. Example: "StartPB". |
| `limit` | integer | no | Most matches to return. Default 50, maximum 200. |

#### `ftview_check`

Run structural checks over one opened export: tag CSV integrity, duplicate names within displays and the tag file, and files that did not parse. Vendor XSD validation and PLC binding are not performed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |

#### `ftview_compare`

Compare two opened exports by display name, tag name and file content hash.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before_id` | string | yes | View id of the earlier export. |
| `after_id` | string | yes | View id of the later export. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Number of rows to skip. Default 0. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Most rows to return. Default 50, maximum 200. |

### FTView edit

Stage display and tag edits. `ftview_apply` writes a new export folder and leaves the source untouched.

#### `ftview_draft_display_set`

Stage one attribute change on a display or on one of its named objects. Nothing is written until ftview_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `display` | string | yes | Display name as listed by ftview_list. Example: "Main". |
| `object` | string | no | Object name inside the display. Omit to change the display root. Example: "StartPB". |
| `attribute` | string | yes | Attribute to set. Example: "visible" or "caption". |
| `value` | string | yes | New attribute value. Example: "0". |

#### `ftview_draft_display_add`

Stage a new display by copying an existing display file under a new name. Nothing is written until ftview_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `copy_from` | string | yes | Display name to copy. Example: "Main". |
| `name` | string | yes | New display name, unique in the export. Example: "MainCopy". |

#### `ftview_draft_tag_upsert`

Stage one HMI tag update: change an existing row's description or type, or append a new tag row. Nothing is written until ftview_apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | string | no | View handle returned by ftview_open. Omit when exactly one export is open in this chat. |
| `name` | string | yes | Tag name. Example: "StartPB". |
| `description` | string | no | New tag description. Example: "Start pushbutton". |
| `type` | string | no | New tag type. Example: "A" for analog or "D" for digital. |

#### `ftview_validate`

Prepare the staged edits: apply them to a re-parsed copy, report the changed files and the new structural findings. Writes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | string | no | Draft handle returned by an ftview_draft_* tool. Omit when exactly one draft exists in this chat. |

#### `ftview_apply`

Write the prepared edits to a NEW export folder: changed files get the edits, other text exports are copied verbatim. The source folder is never modified.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft_id` | string | no | Draft handle returned by an ftview_draft_* tool. Omit when exactly one draft exists in this chat. |
| `output_root` | string | yes | New folder for the edited export. It must not exist. Example: "C:/Projects/Line/ME Export Edited". |

### FTView Studio

Plan the manual FactoryTalk View Studio import for changed displays.

#### `ftview_studio_status`

Discover installed FactoryTalk View ME tooling: product folders, ME XSD schemas, help files and the Add Component utility. Read-only; does not start Studio or prove licensing.

No parameters.

#### `ftview_studio_preflight`

Check the files that differ between two opened exports for a manual Studio import: parse state, name restrictions, discovered utility and schemas. Writes nothing and starts no Studio.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before_id` | string | yes | View id of the export before the edit. |
| `after_id` | string | yes | View id of the edited export. |

#### `ftview_studio_handoff`

Return the ordered manual FactoryTalk View Studio import plan for the changed displays between two opened exports. No vendor utility runs and no file is written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before_id` | string | yes | View id of the export before the edit. |
| `after_id` | string | yes | View id of the edited export. |
| `application` | string | yes | ME application name the human opens in Studio. Example: "Line". |
